hooks.name: vetcode-guard
hooks.description: Checks the packages a shell command would install, and the programs an MCP configuration would start, before they run.

hooks.name: vetcode-clone-check
hooks.description: Reads a repository right after git clone, before anything from it runs.

hooks.name: vetcode-memory-ledger
hooks.description: Reports memory files and hooks that changed since an agent last wrote them.
